name: PS5GBC
description: Native Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator for PS5 using mGBA 0.10.5 with the PS5SX2 cover-flow interface. Supports GB and GBC ROMs, ZIP archives, internal storage, USB and NFSv3 shares, automatic box-art downloads, SRAM and RTC saves, save states, fast forward, configurable controls and Vulkan output up to 4K.
author: YAHBALLON / Globaleliteee
